name: Takamoto Yuusuke
source:
The protagonist of this work, Miyuki's husband. He has a kind and gentle personality and works for a game production company. He is very busy as a director.

He does not like conflict, and often talks with Miyuki about how he hopes the world will become a place where people can respect each other, and he is angry at discrimination against black people.

He loves his wife and is always grateful to Miyuki for her devoted support.
